stops.name: Chapel Bridge
stops.quote: The Chapel Bridge with its cycle of paintings is the undisputed landmark of Lucerne.
stops.english: The Chapel Bridge with its cycle of paintings is the undisputed landmark of Lucerne.

stops.name: Musegg Wall
stops.quote: There is a fantastic view of the city, lake and mountains from the Musegg Wall with its nine towers.
stops.english: There is a fantastic view of the city, lake and mountains from the Musegg Wall with its nine towers.

stops.name: Jesuit Church
stops.quote: Between the two iconic wooden bridges over the Reuss is the Jesuit Church with its onion domes.
stops.english: Between the two iconic wooden bridges over the Reuss is the Jesuit Church with its onion domes.

stops.name: Swiss Museum of Transport
stops.quote: Take a stroll along the wide waterfront promenade opposite with its elegant hotels to the Museum of Transport.
stops.english: Take a stroll along the wide waterfront promenade opposite with its elegant hotels to the Museum of Transport.

stops.name: Pilatus
stops.quote: Lucerne’s local mountain scores points for its fondue gondola and the largest suspension rope park in Switzerland on the Fräkmüntegg.
stops.english: Lucerne’s local mountain scores points for its fondue gondola and the largest suspension rope park in Switzerland on the Fräkmüntegg.

stops.name: Rigi
stops.quote: Discover the top excursion destinations in the region: Brunnen on the “ Swiss Path”, Vitznau with the Rigi or Alpnachstad with the Pilatus.
stops.english: Discover the top excursion destinations in the region: Brunnen on the “ Swiss Path”, Vitznau with the Rigi or Alpnachstad with the Pilatus.

stops.name: Lion Monument Lucerne
stops.quote: The path through the picturesque old town with its squares and fountains leads you to another popular sight with photographers, the “ Lion of Lucerne”.
stops.english: The path through the picturesque old town with its squares and fountains leads you to another popular sight with photographers, the “ Lion of Lucerne”.

stops.name: KKL
stops.quote: Start your tour around the lake at the unique KKL next to the train station.
stops.english: Start your tour around the lake at the unique KKL next to the train station.

stops.quote: Learn more about: Lucerne Schlössli Utenberg
